newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures mostly down, off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures mostly down, off early highs.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures gave up some of their early gains to end Friday mostly lower as late profit-taking overwhelmed technical buying, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.5 yen per kg lower to 0.1 yen firmer. Benchmark March was 0.2 yen lower at 134.3 yen.
Activity was lacklustre amid a lack of fresh factors.
The market started the day on a firmer tone, supported by the yen's weakness against the dollar, the traders said. Trade was mixed during the day.
"Further gains could be limited amid expectations that rubber stocks will continue climbing," one trader said.
